prompt:
TESSERA STYLE SHEET
1. Modern editorial paper collage: bold magazine composition, refined 2D motion design, photographed flat under soft room light.
2. One flat block-colour paper ground fills the frame: deep magenta. The ground is a single unbroken colour.
3. Subjects are black-and-white halftone photographic cutouts with rough white torn-paper edges: objects, machines, buildings, maps, coins, screens, vehicles, anonymous paper hands. Every cutout is a plain, unmarked object: calendar pages, documents, coins, screens and vehicles are blank and unprinted, with no lettering, numerals, symbols, liveries or marks on them.
4. Diagram elements are flat matte paper shapes and ribbons in cream, black, pale yellow, or the ground's contrasting colour, with real paper texture, print dots and small pieces of tape.
5. One consistent light from the upper left; each paper layer casts a small soft shadow.
6. Every surface is matte printed paper reflecting only the room light: cutouts, chips, ribbons and ground all read as photographed paper, with the same flat finish edge to edge. No glow, neon, bloom or halo anywhere.
7. Layout: the headline chip owns the upper third of the frame and stays uncovered; subjects and diagrams occupy the lower two-thirds. When the frame opens on a previous composition, its elements slide off or are covered in the first second and the new headline lands on clear ground.
8. Headline typography: one extra-bold sans-serif in black or cream, printed on a cream or black paper chip, large, with safe margins. Letterforms are accurate, complete and stable from the frame they appear in; the chip is printed once and does not redraw.
9. Motion: elements enter fast with slight overshoot and a stable landing, then hold a clear reading window; one strongest focus at a time; the camera is locked; movement starts on the first frame and a small loop continues at the end; no empty frames.
10. 16:9, exactly 5 seconds, one composition, at most one crisp cut.
11. Identity anchor: rough white torn edges on every cutout; small paper shadow from the upper-left light.

BEAT
Ground: deep magenta.
Subjects: nine paper calendar pages; a paper hand.
Opens on the price tag, carried over from the previous shot, which transforms as the action begins.
Action: The previous chip slides off as the price tag fans into nine calendar pages; a paper hand enters and holds over the last one.
Ends holding on the pointing hand.
Headline printed on a paper chip: "6–9 MONTHS".

ON-SCREEN TEXT: "6–9 MONTHS". This string is printed complete and correct from its first visible frame and never changes. It is the only lettering in the frame.

AUDIO: One English narrator, warm, clear, natural, brisk but unhurried, never an advertising shout. Speak the following line exactly once, word for word, beginning on the first frame: "The next six to nine months are make-or-break.". No other dialogue. Light paper-slap and tape sound effects beneath the voice; no music.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] This is a cinematic, modern editorial paper collage shot, photographed flat under soft room light. The scene opens on <Picture 1>, featuring a deep magenta flat block-color paper ground. In the upper third, a cream-colored paper chip displays the black sans-serif text "$34M MARKET CAP". In the center, a blank white paper price tag with a circular hole rests atop a black-and-white halftone photographic cutout of a circular object, both featuring rough white torn-paper edges. A consistent light source from the upper left casts small, soft shadows beneath every paper layer. Immediately, the camera remains in a Static Shot as the "$34M MARKET CAP" chip slides rapidly off-screen to the left. Simultaneously, a new cream paper chip slides in from the right and lands firmly in the upper third, featuring the large, extra-bold black sans-serif text "6–9 MONTHS". In the lower two-thirds, the white price tag rapidly fans out and transforms into a sequence of nine identical, blank black-and-white halftone calendar page cutouts, each with rough white torn edges, spreading across the magenta ground. As the pages settle with a slight overshoot, a black-and-white halftone photographic cutout of an anonymous paper hand (S1) enters from the right edge of the frame and slides over the final calendar page, pointing toward it. The hand and pages hold a stable position for the remainder of the video. All elements maintain a matte printed paper texture with no glow or bloom. An English narrator (S1), with a warm, clear, and natural mid-range voice, says in an off-screen voiceover: <d>[English] The next six to nine months are make-or-break.</d> The narrator's voice begins on the first frame.

overall_soundscape: The audio is dominated by the narrator's voice, underpinned by rhythmic, tactile foley. Distinct sounds of paper slapping against a flat surface and the sharp, sticky peel and press of adhesive tape synchronize with the movement of the chips and the fanning of the calendar pages.
